name: AwardSpace
tagline: Genuinely free, ad-free web hosting, plus low-cost unlimited paid plans
description: AwardSpace is a free web hosting provider offering a real no-cost, ad-free plan with capped storage and bandwidth, plus paid shared plans with unlimited storage.
about: AwardSpace is best known for its free hosting tier — one of the few that doesn't plaster ads across your site. The free plan gives you 1GB of SSD storage, 5GB of monthly bandwidth, one MySQL database, and a free subdomain (no custom domain included), with PHP/MySQL support and one-click WordPress or Joomla installs. It's a genuinely usable option for a small hobby site, portfolio, or a WordPress install you're learning on — but the storage and bandwidth caps are real, and there's no money-back guarantee or premium support tier attached to a $0 plan.

For anyone outgrowing the free tier, AwardSpace's paid shared hosting starts at a low headline price and scales up through mid and top tiers that add unlimited domains, unlimited storage and bandwidth, PostgreSQL and Perl support, and (on the top plan) ASP.NET. All paid plans carry a 30-day money-back guarantee, unlike the free tier.

AwardSpace is a budget host first and foremost — the free plan is a legitimate way to get a small site online at zero cost, and the paid plans are aimed at price-sensitive shoppers rather than users chasing premium performance or support SLAs.
policies: Paid AwardSpace plans include a 30-day money-back guarantee; the free plan has no refund policy since no payment is involved and carries no uptime SLA or guaranteed support response time.
The free plan is capped at 1GB storage and 5GB monthly bandwidth on a subdomain — sites that exceed these limits need to upgrade to a paid plan for unlimited storage and bandwidth.
